profile.headline: Senior Nuclear Methods Engineer | AI Strategy & Governance

positions.title: Senior Nuclear Methods Software Engineer
positions.description:
Nuclear Methods Engineer operating across reactor physics V&V for neutronic design and analysis, and applied AI strategy for nuclear documentation and knowledge management. Co-led the development and deployment of TerraPower's first production AI application, building organizational procedures, cross-functional stakeholder alignment across legal and IT, and scaling the project to an agentic use case. 

- Perform validation of internal fast-reactor neutronics software under an NQA-1 
program, coupling MCNP stochastic analysis with deterministic multigroup cross-section generation (MC²-3) and variational nodal transport flux solvers (DIF3D-VARIANT). Benchmarked against IRPhEP-evaluated critical experiments (BFS-1, 
ZPPR) and additional experimental data obtained under national laboratory 
agreements. 

- Presented NLP research on nuclear outage severity prediction at ANS, identifying critical domain data gaps and proposing a corpus development roadmap using Licensee Event Reports and synthetic accident scenario generation.

-  Presented production RAG and knowledge-graph retrieval work at NRC AI Workshop #7 (2026) and NRC AI Symposium (2025)

positions.title: Nuclear Design Engineer
positions.description: Nuclear design engineer specializing in the design and licensing applications for transportation and storage of spent nuclear fuel. Applications involve radiation shielding, criticality safety and decay heat analysis while demonstrating compliance to nuclear regulatory limits.

positions.title: Nuclear Analyst Intern
positions.description: Spent most of the internship using Python to help develop software implementing nuclear regulatory guide 3.54, Rev. 2 for determining decay heat of spent nuclear fuel. Also had an opportunity to work with SCALE and MCNP.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.insights: Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Python (Programming Language)
